## Testing Mode
RED

This task IS the RED test — it writes the failing integration test suite. The script under test (pr-comment-response.sh) does not exist yet, so the test will fail (RED) by design. Subsequent implementation stories (238c-d60a and later) must make this test pass (GREEN).

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD1: Mock fixture exists with accept/defend/defer comments including reply-in-thread for root_comment_id chain-walk
- DD2: Integration test suite runs and confirms FAILING (RED) before implementation begins
- DD3: Mock enforces no real gh api calls or GitHub MCP tool calls escape during the test run

## Approach
Follow the established bash integration test pattern from:
  - tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh  (_make_stub_dir pattern)
  - tests/integration/test-merge-to-main-pr-thread-resolution.sh  (RED test design)

## Implementation Notes

### Test file location
tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh

### gh Stub Design
Use _make_stub_dir pattern from test-github-defense-store.sh:
  - Create a temp dir with a gh shim (bash script that logs argv + emits canned JSON)
  - Controlled by env vars: GH_CALL_LOG, GH_EXIT_CODE, STUB_GH_SCENARIO
  - Stub must record call counts for each gh subcommand
  - Stub MUST NOT actually call gh (enforces no real API calls)

### Mock fixture design
The mock serves a PR with exactly 3 comments:
  1. accept_comment: comment requesting a code change
  2. defend_comment: comment questioning a design decision (no code change needed)
  3. defer_comment: comment that is out-of-scope/ambiguous
The defer comment is a REPLY in a thread (to exercise root_comment_id chain-walk):
  - root comment: any comment with in_reply_to_id = null
  - reply: defer comment with in_reply_to_id = root comment's id

### Script invocation
The test must invoke pr-comment-response.sh (which does NOT exist yet). The invocation will fail with "command not found" or similar — this is the expected RED behavior. Use a guard:
  SCRIPT="$REPO_ROOT/plugins/dso/scripts/pr-comment-response.sh"
  if ! test -f "$SCRIPT"; then
      echo "RED: pr-comment-response.sh not found (expected RED state)"
      (( ++FAIL ))
  fi
And then add the behavioral assertions that MUST pass once the script exists:
  - sc1_fetch_verify: the normalized JSON file exists with required schema fields
  - sc1_reply_count: all three thread reply gh calls were made (3 calls to gh api .../replies)
  - sc2_accept_commit: accept-classified comment resulted in a commit (git log shows a commit after run)
  - sc3_defend_not_null: defense_comment_id is non-null in the normalized JSON
  - sc4_defer_ticket: defer ticket ID is present in the normalized JSON

### Mock boundary enforcement
The mock MUST fail if real gh api calls escape. Do NOT use real GITHUB_TOKEN; use
a fake token value. The stub records all argv to GH_CALL_LOG; the test asserts that
no call in the log includes a real GitHub API hostname (api.github.com). This tests
the negative: no real calls escaped.

Alternatively: set the stub to exit 42 (reserved sentinel) if the GH_TOKEN is the
"real" token value — ensuring any code path that forgets to use the stub fails visibly.

### Test structure (Given/When/Then)
Each test function follows the behavioral testing standard:
  test_fetch_produces_normalized_json_schema:
    Given: gh stub returns canned PR comments JSON, GITHUB_TOKEN is fake, normalized JSON output path is temp dir
    When: pr-comment-response.sh is called with --pr-number 42 --output /tmp/comments.json
    Then: normalized JSON exists with fields: comment_id, root_comment_id, thread_url, body, author, is_inline, already_replied, defense_comment_id

  test_reply_in_thread_root_comment_id_resolved:
    Given: gh stub returns the 3-comment fixture including reply-in-thread (defer comment has in_reply_to_id = root id)
    When: pr-comment-response.sh fetches comments
    Then: the defer comment in output JSON has root_comment_id equal to the root comment's id (not its own id)

  test_accept_comment_produces_commit:
    Given: accept comment in fixture; git repo in temp dir (clean state)
    When: pr-comment-response.sh processes accept comment
    Then: git log shows a new commit referencing the accept comment

  test_defend_comment_defense_comment_id_non_null:
    Given: defend comment in fixture
    When: pr-comment-response.sh processes defend comment
    Then: normalized JSON defense_comment_id is non-null for the defend comment

  test_defer_comment_ticket_id_in_json:
    Given: defer comment in fixture
    When: pr-comment-response.sh processes defer comment
    Then: normalized JSON contains a non-empty ticket_id for the defer comment

  test_no_real_api_calls_escape:
    Given: GITHUB_TOKEN set to fake value; stub logs all calls
    When: pr-comment-response.sh runs full pipeline
    Then: no entry in GH_CALL_LOG contains "api.github.com" (no real calls escaped)

## File Impact
| File | Action | Notes |
|------|--------|-------|
| tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh | create | The integration test suite |

## Pattern Reference
# from tests/integration/test-github-defense-store.sh:30-80
_make_stub_dir() {
    local d
    d=$(mktemp -d "/tmp/dso-defense-store-stubs.XXXXXX")
    _TEST_TMPDIRS+=("$d")
    cat > "$d/gh" <<'"'"'GHEOF'"'"'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
LOG="${GH_CALL_LOG:-/dev/null}"
{ printf '"'"'CALL'"'"'; for a in "$@"; do printf '"'"'\t%s'"'"' "$a"; done; printf '"'"'\n'"'"'; } >> "$LOG" 2>/dev/null || true
exit "${GH_EXIT_CODE:-0}"
GHEOF
    chmod +x "$d/gh"
    echo "$d"
}

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately

## Escalation Policy
Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Integration test file exists at tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
  Verify: test -f $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
- [ ] Test file is executable
  Verify: test -x $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
- [ ] Running the test suite exits non-zero (RED state confirmed)
  Verify: bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh; [ $? -ne 0 ]
- [ ] Test file contains at least 5 behavioral test functions (Given/When/Then)
  Verify: grep -c "^test_" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh | awk '"'"'{exit ($1 < 5)}'"'"'
- [ ] Test file contains a gh stub (_make_stub_dir or equivalent) that does not call real gh
  Verify: grep -q "_make_stub_dir\|STUB_DIR\|GH_CALL_LOG" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
- [ ] Test fixture includes accept, defend, and defer comments
  Verify: grep -qE "accept|defend|defer" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
- [ ] Test fixture includes a reply-in-thread comment (in_reply_to_id present)
  Verify: grep -q "in_reply_to_id" $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py 2>/dev/null; shellcheck --severity=error $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/integration/test-pr-comment-response-integration.sh 2>/dev/null || true
